articles.title: Roman Telescope Set to Reveal 100,000 Hidden Worlds Across the Galaxy
articles.summary: NASA's Roman telescope could uncover 100,000 exoplanets, dwarfing the 6,300 known today. By scanning the Milky Way's uncharted center and far side, it will reveal how planet formation varies with stellar chemistry and galactic environment.

articles.title: How a DIY Robot with 'Air-Muscles' Pioneered Humanoid Locomotion
articles.summary: In 1987, a photographer with no robotics training built a bipedal robot using pneumatic 'air-muscles.' Shadow Walker could stand and balance, and it competed in the 1990 Robot Olympics—wearing pants to conceal its unconventional actuators.

articles.title: Jackie the Eagle Delivers a 'Dramatic Slap' to Nocturnal Nest Intruder
articles.summary: Internet-famous bald eagle Jackie swatted a flying squirrel named Fiona during a late-night nest visit. The livestreamed moment highlights the constant vigilance of eagle parents raising chicks Sandy and Luna in California's Big Bear Valley.
